notes: Pages were fetched with curl one at a time and reduced to plain text; quotes are copied from that text (the page reader truncated or summarised several pages). (2) Snackpass's stored 'Pro' 499 is now its creator-marketing plan, not ordering; ordering has no public price. (3) Zay-OS plans are now 'Site' $399 and 'All' $499; the stored 'Concierge' 599 is gone. (4) Order Tiger, Outbites, Zay-OS, EasyEats and RapidOrderz each have dedicated food-truck pages/wording, so focus is set to food_truck (some were stored as restaurant tools). (5) ChowNow refused the TLS handshake on every URL; RapidOrderz is JavaScript-only. (6) Foody Gram prices have the '$' in a separate span, so page text reads '$159/month'. (7) Menufy's 'Setup Advanced Orders' help page (support.menufy.com) answered 403; its per-15-minute slot cap was therefore not quoted. (8) Owner.com's 'scheduled pickup' wording is only in an image description (alt text).
